results.scope: For each of the 22 chambers with a short chain of size at most four, the certified polynomial F_{a,w} (data generated from the certificate files) is nonnegative at every gap vector with nonnegative entries in any linearly ordered field; the chamber words for a = 1, ..., 4 are exactly the Dyck words. The kernel evaluates the Boolean certificate test; soundness is proved for arbitrary data.
